question: Using only the data from the ‘results’ table, find the three years in which the sum of the highest total points earned by any driver and the highest total points earned by any constructor in that year (both calculated by summing up points from the ‘results’ table) is smallest, and list those three years in order of ascending total.
sql:
WITH driver_points_by_year AS (
    SELECT r.year, res.driver_id, SUM(res.points) AS total_driver_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, res.driver_id
),
max_driver_points_by_year AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(total_driver_points) AS max_driver_total
    FROM driver_points_by_year
    GROUP BY year
),
constructor_points_by_year AS (
    SELECT r.year, res.constructor_id, SUM(res.points) AS total_constructor_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, res.constructor_id
),
max_constructor_points_by_year AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(total_constructor_points) AS max_constructor_total
    FROM constructor_points_by_year
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 
    mdpy.year,
    mdpy.max_driver_total,
    mcpy.max_constructor_total,
    mdpy.max_driver_total + mcpy.max_constructor_total AS combined_total
FROM max_driver_points_by_year mdpy
JOIN max_constructor_points_by_year mcpy ON mdpy.year = mcpy.year
ORDER BY combined_total ASC
LIMIT 3;
